comments.text:
Arc 14 shipped at commit 3324c14.

Phase A surface (sub-project naming/location decision): PRINCIPAL confirmed shape (a) — sub-project lives at <parent>/<subproject-slug>/, sharing parent's git repo and bw, disambiguated by _<slug> suffix on every agent file. Sub-project working files (not just envelopes) live in the same directory.

Deliverables landed:
- install.sh: --target subproject --parent-dir <path> --subproject <slug> mode (validation, idempotency, dry-run, next-step guidance)
- MAJOR_POLYBIUS.md §10: sub-project spawning section (trigger recognition, walk-through, asymmetric bw visibility recursive, hand-off)
- ONBOARDING.md Scenario 5: design-tier sub-project under The Stoa (roster-redesign + Reese in human-loop seat)
- templates/consent-prompts.md Prompt 7: sub-project-spawn consent
- templates/paste-instruction-template.md: small ROLE_FILE_PATH note for sub-project tier

Phase F smoke test: synthetic parent w/ git+bw+parent-tier substrate; all directive Part E conditions verified (install runs clean, suffixed files at expected paths, dry-run works, parent CLAUDE.md sha256 unchanged, parent .claude/MAJOR_*.md untouched, bw NOT re-initialized, sub-project sees parent's tickets, no templates dir under sub-project, validation rejects --modify-claude-md / bad slugs / missing parent-dir).

Voice audit clean — only COLONEL matches are deliberate reserved-rank discussion in MAJOR_POLYBIUS.md.

Pre-existing bug surfaced during regression check (--project-dir . produces slug '_'), scoped out of Arc 14 to keep the diff focused, ticketed at stoa--8o4 with a concrete fix sketch.

v2 architecture is now end-to-end deployable: substrate (Arcs 1-7) + propagation/consolidation (Arcs 8 + Z) + The Stoa rebuild (Arcs 9-13) + recursive sub-project capability (Arc 14). PRINCIPAL may want to mark this milestone (planning v2 spec update / retrospective / possibly v2.1 capture if anything from Arcs 1-14 surfaced empirical revisions to the spec itself).

title: [EPIC] Arc 14 — sub-project spawning mechanism (final v2 arc)
